defect_detection.technique: Pattern Recognition (self-referential; the design STL/JSON is never read)
defect_detection.rule: missing if a gap covers >= 85% of the strut's free length, broken if a gap cuts it but covers < 85%
defect_detection.coordinates: position / mark_position: CT voxels (x, y, z), z = slice index. junction indices: place inside the unit cell (0, 0.5, 1). unit_cell indices: cell number from the lattice corner, estimated from the scan. Strut ids are the detector's own lattice numbering, not the design JSON's ids.
